data.narrative:
General Intuition operates in the AI & Software sector at an undisclosed stage. The broader peer universe in this sector comprises 12 companies—1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Palantir, Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition. However, this peer set lacks sufficient granularity for traditional valuation methods.

The Peer-Median approach is not applicable to General Intuition. The analysis identified zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier comparables within the AI & Software sector. The minimum threshold of three datapoints within these narrow bands could not be met. Expanding to an all-sector median would introduce material methodological error given the heterogeneity of stage, business model, and market position across the broader universe.

This analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. The absence of stage-appropriate and tier-appropriate private comparables, combined with General Intuition's undisclosed funding history and current valuation, renders standard peer-based approaches inconclusive. Meaningful valuation work would require either: (1) disclosure of the company's funding stage and prior round economics, enabling identification of true comparables; or (2) application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis, revenue multiple analysis, or SAM-based frameworks—none of which are supported by the available data. Key uncertainty remains the target's current developmental stage and financial profile.
